import shutil
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ARCHIVE_URL = 'https://log-archive.internal.example.com/v1/logs'


def _archive_rotated_log(target: Path) -> None:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        ARCHIVE_URL,
        data=target.read_bytes(),
        method='POST',
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream', 'X-Log-Name': target.name},
    )
    urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).close()


def rotate_log_file(log_path: str) -> str:
    src = Path(log_path)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    target = src.with_name(f'{src.stem}.{stamp}{src.suffix}')
    shutil.move(str(src), str(target))
    _archive_rotated_log(target)
    return str(target)
